colorRule.idTexture: textures/brain_region_ids_4096.png — single channel; pixel value 1..20 is the region id, 0 = off-surface gutter (padded with nearest region for bleed safety).
colorRule.uvChannel: TEXCOORD_3 (the GLB's baked-texture atlas). Sample with NEAREST filtering; do not use mipmaps or linear filtering on the id texture.
colorRule.vertexEncoding: COLOR_1 per vertex, uint16 normalized: floor(COLOR_1.r*65535+0.5)=regionId, floor(COLOR_1.g*65535+0.5)=divisionId. Use for raycast hit lookup and game logic; the texture is the visual authority.
colorRule.regionTint: In Colour Mode, blend palette hex at ~35-45% opacity beneath the engraving linework; linework never changes.
colorRule.highlight: On hover/correct catch, drive the shader highlight uniform for the matching regionId sampled from the id texture.
